comment: Stage 2 library. Every robot is assembled from these ids - no robot ever hard-codes stats. Weapon damage output is DERIVED (rotor inertia + tip speed -> energy; weapon-motor power -> spin-up time), never stated. Stage 6 (workshop) reads the chassis `attach` points; Stage 7 reads hp/repair fields.

spec.comment: Unpowered. Damages only through ram energy, but it is the cheapest way to control an opponent.
Low and flat: on 8in or bigger wheels the tyres stand proud top and bottom, so it drives inverted.
Room for a hammer or crusher actuator inside.
Long wheelbase: stable for flippers and drums.
Short and wide: a stable platform for a big horizontal weapon.
A drum-shaped base for shells, domes and turrets.
Small and light - leaves weight for a big weapon, or for a second robot.
The same envelope as the mid box, in hardened steel.
The whole shell is the weapon: mount it with body mount "shell".
Pushes off the floor to roll the robot back onto its wheels.
The small half of a multibot.
